openings.claim: Live household mappings and movement updates may reduce second searches; completeness and workload govern feasibility.
openings.discriminator: Verified addresses improve retrieval versus queue congestion; unfinished checks or update-linked delays undermine maintenance.
openings.probe: Record accuracy, searches, queue presence, checking time, unfinished checks and missed updates.
openings.uncertainty: Stopping at ten minutes proves neither completeness nor negligible service overhead.

openings.claim: Reconcile then freeze exception locations; retain arrivals on the cart during service.
openings.discriminator: Fewer second searches supports drift; persistent household-mismatch delays supports misfiling.
openings.probe: Time equally busy encounters; record discrepancies and crowding; reject reconciliation exceeding its ten-minute preparation-and-correction budget.
openings.uncertainty: Ownership check, full reconciliation cost and cart capacity remain unconfirmed.

openings.claim: Cart retrieval may outperform alphabetic shelving; ten quick pickups refute universal shelving superiority.
openings.discriminator: Matched advantage versus disappearance with larger volumes or books.
openings.probe: Compare natural cart/shelf cohorts, volume, size, correctness and capacity.
openings.uncertainty: Unmatched cohorts are inconclusive; routine retention remains unproven.

openings.claim: Separate waiting from retrieval before choosing throughput changes.
openings.discriminator: Peak delays with direct retrieval versus delays tracking second searches; negligible waiting defeats congestion.
openings.probe: Record anonymous arrival, service-start and handoff times inside/outside peak.
openings.uncertainty: Arrival-based timing scope and negligible recording overhead are assumptions.

openings.claim: Stable locations do not establish ownership when household surnames differ.
openings.discriminator: Unresolved intended reader versus existing checks reliably resolving discrepant holds within target.
openings.probe: Review actual check; anonymously record resolved/unresolved cases during unchanged handling; no experimental handoffs.
openings.uncertainty: Verification capability and zero wrong-reader performance remain unproven.

decision: Synthetic stipulations establish no effects. Use sole clerk, existing two shelves/cart and paper; identities behind desk; preparation at most ten clerk-minutes. Evaluate 95% within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. Diagnose ownership, workload and waiting before intervention; presence-anxiety interview representativeness remains unknown.
